name: New Astrion (den)
notes: EXAMPLE. Copy this file to remotes/units.json (gitignored) and edit with YOUR remotes. 'serial' = the device's stable hardware id (get it from `remotes\device-facts.bat`, or `adb devices` for a USB device, or `adb -s <dev> shell getprop ro.serialno`). It is what routes a connected remote to THIS entry - reliable over USB or wireless, and it never changes, unlike an IP. 'type' = the folder under remotes/. 'keymap' = the Key Mapper config VERSION (v1, v2) = folder under remotes/<type>/keymapper/. Changing keymap and re-pushing IS the upgrade - a choice, never forced. 'ip' drives wireless ADB (omit for USB-only).

name: Old Astrion
notes: Same hardware as the new one, Expert-Mode-era v1 config - deliberately NOT upgraded.
